thread:
Maria CS: Heads up — Acme renewal next Thu. They flagged SLO acceptance + evidence pack for legal review. Need a concise checklist by EOD Wed. Can ops/legal owners confirm?
Simon SRE: I can own the evidence bundle. Will collect uptime graphs, latency p99 for last 90d, and the incident timeline.
Anne Legal: I need explicit wording for credits and termination triggers. Please include the clause references we agreed in the template.
Raj Sales: Acme will expect the doc to match the quote. I'm copying their procurement lead in the meeting invite.
Priya Onboarding: I'll validate onboarding acceptance items (logs access, runbooks handed off). Any special telemetry they asked for?
Maria CS: Great. Simon — can you run a quick baseline acceptable p99 for their workload? They run a lot of short-chat requests (avg seq 64).
Simon SRE: On it. Quick command I'll run on prod metrics: ```sum(rate(requests[30d])) by (model); histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(latency_bucket[30d])) by (le))``` will get p99; will attach charts.
Anne Legal: For credits, keep it as a table: Incident window, observed downtime, credit pct, calc. Use the standard formula from contract appendix B. I'll review once Simon posts numbers.
Raj Sales: Also note renewal negotiation: if we need to offer one-time onboarding credit, flag it now so finance can pre-approve.
Maria CS: Ops-bot — can you export the last 90d uptime csv for acme-prod?
ops-bot: Export queued: /artifacts/exports/acme-prod-uptime-90d.csv (ETA 6m). :white_check_mark:
Simon SRE: Uploaded charts + raw p99 values to the thread: /files/acme_slo_evidence_90d.png and /files/acme_p99_values.csv
Priya Onboarding: Quick check — they requested runbook walkthrough recording. I can schedule a 30m session Thu AM. Who wants to join?
Maria CS: Please invite Anne for legal sign-off and Simon for runbook Qs. Raj pls invite procurement.
Raj Sales: Will do. One more ask from Acme: they want a simple one-page summary they can share with their CISO. Can someone draft that?
Anne Legal: I can draft the SLO/credit summary language. Keep it non-legalistic.
Simon SRE: I'll supply the figures and a tiny diagram of failover path.
Maria CS: Action items: Simon = evidence bundle + uptime charts (due Wed 12:00pm). Anne = credit table + one-pager language (due Wed 4:00pm). Priya = schedule runbook session (Thu 09:00am). Raj = invite procurement + attach commercial quote copy. ops-bot = confirm csv export link.
Simon SRE: Noted. If anyone needs the raw traces for a specific incident I can redact and share.
Anne Legal: I'll loop in finance for the credit math if needed.
Maria CS: Thanks team — I'll consolidate into a single PDF and circulate to Acme for pre-review. If we hit blockers, we'll escalate to Escalations channel. :thumbsup:
